summary_en: Komori Corporation repurchased 1.2 million shares (2.3% of outstanding shares) on September 7, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 off-market trading at 2,004 yen per share, for a total of 2.4048 billion yen. The purchase aimed to optimize capital structure and improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock via Off-Market Trading Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
Komori Corporation's board of directors authorized on September 4, 2026 the purchase of up to 1.2 million treasury shares, representing 2.3% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock as of June 30, 2026 (53,062,642 shares). The repurchase was executed via ToSTNeT-3 off-market trading on September 7, 2026 at 2,004 yen per share, the closing price on September 4, for a maximum aggregate consideration of 2.4048 billion yen. Results were announced after the 8:45 a.m. transaction window closed.

The company stated that the repurchase is not a short-term stock price measure but a capital structure optimization initiative aligned with capital cost and market valuation considerations. The objective is to improve capital efficiency and enhance medium- to long-term enterprise value. A major shareholder, Brandes Investment Partners L.P., communicated its intention to sell a portion of its shareholding in connection with this ToSTNeT-3 transaction. The purchase order was valid only during the specified trading time window, and execution of all or part of the shares was subject to market conditions.
